fw.title: Managed Firewall Services
fw.intro: Our managed firewall services give you comprehensive protection against cyber threats and ensure the security of your company network. With our advanced firewall technology, we minimize risks, protect confidential data and secure your business-critical applications.
fw.s1_text: We adapt the firewall settings to your specific requirements and optimize them regularly to ensure efficient defense against attacks.
fw.s2_text: Through continuous analysis of threat intelligence and rapid response, we protect your company against the latest cyber attacks.
fw.s3_text: You receive regular reports on the security status of your network, as well as support in complying with relevant security standards and regulations.
fw.outro: Our managed firewall services give you the confidence that your network is always protected against the latest threats. Rely on our expertise so that you can focus on your core business.
av.heading: Antivirus and Malware Analysis for Comprehensive Security
av.intro: Our antivirus and malware analysis services give you reliable protection against the latest threats to your digital environment. With a proactive approach, we make sure your company is protected from viruses, malware and other malicious attacks.
av.s1_text: Our solutions use constantly updated virus signatures to provide real-time protection against known threats.
av.s2_text: Our experts continuously analyze your network for potential malware threats and take immediate action to prevent infections.
av.s3_text: We use advanced technologies to take effective action even against previously unknown threats, so-called zero-day threats.
av.s4_text: We offer regular training for your team to promote conscious behavior when dealing with potentially harmful content and to strengthen security practices.
av.outro: With our antivirus and malware analysis services, you can rely on your IT infrastructure being optimally protected against digital threats. Focus on your business while we take care of the security of your digital assets.
au.heading: Managed IT Security Services for Comprehensive Protection
au.intro: Our managed IT security services give you all-round protection for your IT infrastructure. We understand the ever-growing challenges in cybersecurity and offer tailored solutions to protect your company from threats.
au.s1_text: Our experts regularly audit your IT infrastructure to identify vulnerabilities and potential risks.
au.s2_text: We simulate realistic attack scenarios to test the resilience of your network against external threats.
au.s3_text: We make sure your security policies meet current best practices and industry-specific standards.
au.s4_text: Based on the audit results, we provide tailored recommendations for action to improve your security posture.
au.outro: With our regular security audits, we make sure your company is always one step ahead when it comes to cybersecurity. Rely on our expertise to continuously optimize your security practices.
net.intro: Our network security services provide comprehensive protection for your IT infrastructure. We understand that the security of your network is of crucial importance and offer tailored solutions to protect your company from cyber threats.
net.s1_text: We configure and monitor your firewall to control traffic and block unauthorized access.
net.s2_text: Our systems proactively detect and prevent intrusion attempts to protect your network from unauthorized access.
net.s3_text: We implement powerful encryption technologies to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of your data.
net.s4_text: By implementing Network Access Control (NAC), we regulate access to your network to ensure that only authorized users and devices can connect.
net.s5_text: Regular security assessments and audits help uncover vulnerabilities and continuously improve security practices.
net.outro: With our network security services, you can rely on your network being protected against the latest threats. Focus on your core business while we take care of the security of your digital infrastructure.
comp.intro: Our compliance management services provide you with comprehensive support in complying with the guidelines of the German Federal Office for Information Security (BSI) and other data protection regulations. We help your company meet information security requirements and ensure the integrity of your IT infrastructure.
comp.s1_text: We make sure your IT infrastructure meets the current BSI guidelines to ensure a high level of information security.
comp.s2_text: We support you in implementing and complying with data protection regulations to ensure the protection of personal data.
comp.s3_text: Regular security assessments and audits ensure continuous compliance and help detect and fix vulnerabilities early.
comp.s4_text: We offer training for your employees to raise awareness of security policies and foster a culture of compliance.
comp.outro: With our compliance management, you can ensure that your company meets the required security standards and protects itself against legal risks. Rely on our expertise to manage your compliance requirements effectively.
cloud.title: Cloud Security for Microsoft 365 - Your Reliable Partner for Data Security
cloud.intro: Our cloud security services provide comprehensive protection for your Microsoft 365 environment. We understand the growing demands on cloud data security and offer tailored solutions to protect your company data from cyber threats.
cloud.s1_text: We implement advanced identity and access management solutions to ensure that only authorized users can access your Microsoft 365 resources.
cloud.s2_text: Our solutions protect your email traffic from malicious attachments, phishing attempts and other threats.
cloud.s3_text: Our team continuously monitors your Microsoft 365 environment for suspicious activity and responds quickly to security incidents.
cloud.s4_text: We support you in complying with data protection regulations and industry-specific standards to meet legal requirements.
cloud.outro: With our cloud security services, you can rely on your Microsoft 365 data being safe and protected. Focus on your core business while we take care of the security of your cloud infrastructure.
